text: Acceptance 14 (threads). Thread-panel send does state.threadMsgs.push(msg) unconditionally; the SSE echo (zdarzenia-sse.js:156) has already inserted the same id, so the reply shows twice. Repro in live UI (port 18804): reply from #th-input -> th-msgs ids [1,2,3,3], texts 'second reply' twice. Fix: upsert by id.
